quote: Sometimes you must walk away in silence. Leaving is not always an act of giving up. It can mean protecting your fragile inner peace. Certain doors were never meant to be opened again. Let the past fade into quiet shadows behind you. Walk forward until the heavy weight finally lifts completely.
